title: Dialogues
subtitle: A2 · Unit 3: Everyday events: what I did

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Listen for the situation first. Then notice the exact action and the follow-up question; the second speaker checks a detail instead of changing the topic.

steps.title: A new bus connection
steps.body: Lina asks Sam how he got to a new French workshop in Ottawa.

examples.fr: Tu as pris le bus jusqu'au centre ?
examples.en: Lina: Did you take the bus downtown?

examples.fr: Oui, puis j'ai pris une correspondance près de la gare.
examples.en: Sam: Yes, then I took a connection near the train station.

examples.fr: Tu as vu le numéro de la ligne sur le billet ?
examples.en: Lina: Did you see the route number on the ticket?

examples.fr: Oui, je l'ai vu à l'accueil.
examples.en: Sam: Yes, I saw it at the welcome desk.

examples.fr: Et tu as trouvé la salle sans problème ?
examples.en: Lina: And did you find the room without a problem?

examples.fr: Oui. J'ai lu le plan de la ville et j'ai vu le nom de la salle.
examples.en: Sam: Yes. I read the city map and saw the room's name.

examples.fr: Tu as eu le temps de lire la consigne ?
examples.en: Lina: Did you have time to read the instruction?

examples.fr: Oui, et j'ai eu le temps de lire la consigne.
examples.en: Sam: Yes, and I had time to read the instruction.

steps.title: After the library visit
steps.body: Nadia asks Awa about her first visit to a public library.

examples.fr: Tu as lu un article pendant ta première visite à la bibliothèque municipale ?
examples.en: Nadia: Did you read an article during your first visit to the public library?

examples.fr: Oui. J'ai lu un article et j'ai trouvé une séance de français.
examples.en: Awa: Yes. I read an article and found a French session.

examples.fr: Tu as pris un livre aussi ?
examples.en: Nadia: Did you take a book too?

examples.fr: Oui, j'ai pris un chapitre facile pour commencer.
examples.en: Awa: Yes, I took an easy chapter to start.

examples.fr: Et tu as eu une carte ?
examples.en: Nadia: And did you get a card?

examples.fr: Pas encore. J'ai fait une demande et j'ai pris le reçu.
examples.en: Awa: Not yet. I made an application and took the receipt.
Nadia: Did you get an answer?

examples.fr: Oui, j'ai eu une réponse par courriel ce matin.
examples.en: Awa: Yes, I got an answer by email this morning.

steps.explain: Sam says the connection was near the train station.

steps.prompt: What did Sam read to find the room?
steps.explain: He says he read the city map and saw the room's name.

steps.prompt: What did Awa do at the public library?
options: She read an article and saw a French session.
She met the instructor at a clinic.
steps.explain: Awa says she read an article and saw a French session.

steps.prompt: What did Awa keep after her application?
steps.explain: Awa says she kept the receipt.
